title: Helicopter crashes and kills at least 3 people near a bus crash in Los Angeles
description: A helicopter crashed in Los Angeles on Tuesday, killing at least three people near a deadly bus crash, officials said. Earlier in the day, two people were killed and six others were injured after an SUV crashed into a city bus.

title: 3 dead after Los Angeles news helicopter crashes in Chatsworth
description: The crash happened near the spot of a deadly Metro bus crash in Chatsworth.

title: News Helicopter Crashes in Los Angeles County, Killing At Least 3
description: NBC4 Los Angeles said the helicopter belonged to the station. The authorities did not immediately confirm how many people were aboard.
